known.summary: `restore` makes the restore folder with the default mode and does not set mode 0700 before or after the extraction. With the usual umask 022 the folder of the decrypted held-out keys is 0755, so every local user can list it and read each key file whose archived mode lets others read it (CWE-276, secret exposure). The usage text and the comment of `restore` promise a new mode-0700 folder. The pull request adds keys.mjs: the base has no such file and no key restore.
